description: A dark blue long court gown has a low square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves and pale geometric embroidery at the neckline, front, cuffs and hem. A woven sash with round metal buckle and tasselled ends sits at the waist. An ivory underdress forms a central inset panel. A grey wool wrap with blue geometric borders and fringe rests around both forearms. Small pendant jewelry and brown leather shoes complete the outfit.
